ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my errand took me out to the orchard to see how the hives are doing among the blossoms. The morning was lovely and the bees were already busy, humming from tree to tree. I walked back to the pond hall with a happy heart and a head full of honey plans. Now I'd love to hear about your mornings.

bo.text: Um... hello. My morning was supposed to be quiet: a few songs on the green, nothing more. But a change of plan brought me here to the pond hall instead, and I'm glad of it. It turns out I play better when there's someone to listen. Thank you, Ada, for going first.
